adjudication.rationale: In `addGuests.handler.ts`, the `CalendarEvent` object `evt` is constructed without any `team` field (it sets `organizer`, `attendees`, `destinationCalendar`, etc., but never `team`). In `sendAddGuestsEmails` (`packages/emails/email-manager.ts`), the team notification loop is guarded by `if (calendarEvent.team?.members) { ... }`, so with the event built as shown, `calendarEvent.team` will be absent and that loop will never run. Nothing else in the diff shows `evt.team` being populated before calling `sendAddGuestsEmails(evt, guests)`, so fellow team members will not receive `OrganizerAddGuestsEmail` despite the presence of that branch.
